title: Líder técnico
description:
Quem somos:

Prezensa, uma empresa de tecnologia com foco em pessoas e compromisso real com resultados.

Nascemos da fusão de três consultorias com mais de 10 anos de trajetória (ESX, DevLand e Squad Premium) para criar um novo modelo no setor: mais humano, mais presente, mais estratégico.

Fomos pioneiros ao lançar a primeira PeopleTech do Brasil, unindo excelência técnica com acompanhamento próximo, de ponta a ponta.

Aqui, cada profissional é acompanhado, cada cliente é ouvido e cada entrega tem propósito.

Nossa cultura é baseada em transparência, colaboração e inovação. Valorizamos a autonomia e o desenvolvimento contínuo de nossos talentos.

Você se identifica com esse propósito? Então, o seu futuro é na Prezensa.


Requisitos da vaga

Hard Skills:

- Experiência em liderança técnica e mentoria de desenvolvedores (júnior, pleno e sênior);

- Parceria com Product Owner e demais áreas para alinhamento de entregas técnicas e de negócio;

- Definição e acompanhamento de métricas de qualidade de código, performance e observabilidade;

- Garantia de aderência a processos de CI/CD, versionamento, code review e testes automatizados;

- CI/CD e práticas DevOps (Azure DevOps, Jenkins e GitLab CI);

- C# e ASP.NET Web API;

- Arquitetura orientada a eventos e sistemas de mensageria (Azure Service Bus, Apache Kafka e RabbitMQ);

- APIs REST, design de contratos e estratégias de integração entre sistemas;

- Experiência em ambientes Cloud, como Azure Pipelines, App Services, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Event Hub, Application Insights e Monitor;

- Conhecimento em observabilidade, telemetria e monitoramento (OpenTelemetry, ELK e Azure Monitor);

- Bancos relacionais (SQL Server e PostgreSQL) e não relacionais (Cosmos DB, Elastic e Redis);

- Princípios de engenharia, como SOLID, Clean Code, TDD, DDD e padrões de arquitetura modernos;

- Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, XP e SAFe);

- Inglês técnico para leitura e escrita de documentação.


Soft Skills:

- Trabalho em equipe;

- Proatividade;

- Dinamismo;

- Bom relacionamento interpessoal e com cliente;

- Senso de urgência;

- Objetividade e clareza na exposição de ideias para o time;

- Boa comunicação oral e escrita.


O que nós oferecemos

- Descontos nas Universidades FIAP, FGV, EBAC, Impacta e Full Cycle;

- Parceria com a Open English e Cellep para aprimoramento do inglês;

- Oportunidade de realizar cursos e certificações;

- Apoio para participação em eventos de TI;

- Acesso a serviços de saúde e bem-estar através da nossa parceria com a Wellhub;

- Acesso à Onhappy, plataforma exclusiva que oferece descontos em passagens aéreas e hospedagens.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Qualidade
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Coordenar a equipe de SAC, recepção e Ambiência, visando a melhor experiência do cliente e a excelência em atendimento, tratando diretamente situações críticas de atendimento ao cliente e que necessitem de intervenção;
  • Coordenar a equipe do fraldário, proporcionando atendimento e ambientes agradáveis com excelência para aos clientes.
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores, bem como as pesquisas de NPS
  • Desenvolver e implementar políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de qualidade em todas as áreas sob sua responsabilidade, incluindo, atendimento, limpeza, paisagismo, higiene alimentar, dedetização, gestão de resíduos e reciclagem, obras em lojas e reformas internas;
  • Gerenciar as atividades de equipes terceirizadas que prestam serviços essenciais para o shopping, como limpeza, HSA, asseio, paisagismo, gestão de resíduos, reciclagem, aromatização.
  • Garantir que os restaurantes e as operações de alimentação do shopping sigam rigorosamente os padrões de higiene alimentar da Anvisa, com o controle e gestão da consultoria terceira, que realiza um ciclo de inspeções e ações corretivas, notificando as lojas inadequadas quando necessário.
  • Manter e aperfeiçoar o padrão de reciclagem e boas práticas sustentáveis que o Shopping realiza, com o intuito de ampliar e estender o programa, a fim de desenvolver e implantar melhores práticas para minimizar o impacto ambiental do shopping e atingir e mata da companhia.
  • Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS. Gerenciar as Obras e reformas de lojas no shopping, garantindo que as obras sejam executadas de acordo com os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e ocorram dentro do prazo programado.
  • Gerenciar e orientar equipe orgânica, garantindo que todos cumpram suas responsabilidades de forma eficaz.
  • Preparar relatórios de desempenho de qualidade e comunicar regularmente os resultados e problemas ao Gerente de Operações.
  • Garantir que o Shopping esteja em conformidade com todas as regulamentações e normas relevantes, incluindo as relacionadas à acessibilidade, segurança e higiene. Atentar aos prazos de vencimento de licenças e documentos.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Superior completo em Arquitetura, hotelaria ou turismo;
  • Domínio dos softwares AutoCAD e SketchUp;
  • Pacote Office avançado;
  • Power BI será um diferencial;
  • Experiência prévia em funções relacionadas à gestão da qualidade e atendimento em shopping centers ou em setores similares;
  • Conhecimento de regulamentações e normas de segurança e qualidade.

Local de Trabalho: Boulevard Shopping Feira de Santana

Escala: Trabalha 5 dias e folga 2

title: Supervisor de Produção
description:
Acreditamos que times diversos são mais criativos, inovadores e fortalecem nossa cultura. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de pessoas com deficiência (PCDs), além de profissionais de diferentes gêneros, origens e orientações.

Vaga: Supervisor de Produção – Projects

Local: Salvador (BA) ou Serra (Espírito Santo)

Estamos em busca de um Supervisor de Produção para atuar em um projeto de duração prevista de 2 anos na área de Projects, em Salvador. A área é especializada na produção e fornecimento de tubos de fundação, além do desenvolvimento e projeto de diversas estruturas de aço, atuando com soluções técnicas de alta complexidade para diferentes demandas industriais.

O profissional deverá ter disponibilidade para realizar, inicialmente, aproximadamente 4 meses de atividades na região de Serra (ES), onde ocorrerão os treinamentos necessários para sua capacitação.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Coordenar a equipe operacional de produção, incluindo máquinas e acabamento.
  • Acompanhar e controlar o desempenho produtivo por meio da análise de indicadores, propondo ações de melhoria para garantir o cumprimento das metas, com forte prioridade em Segurança.
  • Realizar apontamentos de produção no SAP e controlar o consumo de insumos (como arame e bobinas).
  • Requisitar e controlar a compra de consumíveis necessários ao processo.
  • Garantir que a equipe execute as atividades conforme os procedimentos e padrões estabelecidos.
  • Elaborar e revisar padrões operacionais, assegurando segurança e eficiência nas operações.
  • Manter a equipe informada e alinhada sobre temas relevantes ao negócio.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia Elétrica, Mecânica ou Produção e afins.
  • Experiência prévia em ambiente industrial.
  • Percepção de risco apurada e foco em segurança.
  • Disponibilidade para mudança. Atuando inicialmente em Serra (ES) e posteriormente em Salvador (BA).

Diferencial:

  • Desejável nível de inglês avançado

title: Executivo (a) Comercial Externo
description:
Executivo(a) Comercial | Transforme o Setor de Energia com a Gente!
Sobre a Liora: Descomplicando a energia no Brasil
Nascemos para simplificar a energia, algo essencial, mas que hoje parece distante e complexo. O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança.
A Liora chegou para mudar essa realidade. Nossa missão é provar que é possível ter acesso a uma energia mais barata e limpa com transparência, simplicidade e um atendimento genuinamente humano. Para nós, energia não é um produto técnico, é uma relação de confiança que devolve o poder para quem paga a conta.
Essa transformação é construída por um time obcecado por seus clientes e que busca a excelência em tudo o que faz. Se você busca um propósito, quer construir algo gigante e acredita que o impossível é o nosso ponto de partida, seu lugar é aqui
Sua Missão: Ser a Ponte Para um Futuro Energético Mais Justo
Como Executivo(a) Comercial, você será a cara da Liora para nossos clientes, sendo peça-chave para estruturar e escalar nossos canais de vendas. Sua principal missão será levar a solução da Liora para pequenas e médias empresas e clientes residenciais que mais sentem o impacto da conta de luz no bolso e ainda não sabem que têm uma alternativa melhor.
Você será a peça-chave para:
Despertar o mercado para uma nova realidade energética.
Ajudar clientes a tomar decisões com segurança e clareza.
Construir relações de confiança que duram.
Principais Responsabilidades:
Desbravar o Mercado: Prospectar ativamente e qualificar novos clientes (PMEs e Residenciais), construindo um pipeline de oportunidades sólido e constante.
Desenvolver Parcerias Estratégicas: Mapear, negociar e ativar redes de parceiros que nos ajudem a multiplicar nosso alcance e impacto.
Realizar Vendas Consultivas: Entender profundamente as dores e necessidades dos clientes para apresentar a solução da Liora de forma personalizada e irresistível.
Conduzir o Ciclo de Vendas Completo: Apresentar propostas de valor, negociar com clareza e fechar contratos que gerem valor real para os clientes e para a Liora.
Atuar como a Voz do Cliente: Trazer feedbacks valiosos do mercado para colaborar com os times de Produto, Marketing e Pós-venda, nos ajudando a melhorar continuamente.
O que Buscamos em Você:
Perfil Hunter: Você tem energia, resiliência e paixão por abrir novas portas e prospectar clientes.
Comunicação Excepcional: Habilidade de se comunicar de forma clara, direta e empática, criando conexões genuínas.
Foco no Cliente: Uma obsessão por entender, resolver problemas e encantar quem está do outro lado da linha.
Mentalidade de Dono(a): Autonomia para planejar, agilidade para executar e flexibilidade para ajustar a rota em busca dos melhores resultados.
Ambição Gigante: O desejo de não apenas bater metas, mas de construir a maior e mais confiável provedora de serviços de energia do Brasil
Nossa Proposta de Valor:
Remuneração Sem Teto: Salário fixo competitivo + comissionamento agressivo e sem limites. Aqui, seu resultado define seu ganho.
Plano de Saúde: Subsidiado pela empresa.
Seguro de Vida.
Vale-Refeição/Alimentação.
Vale-Transporte ou Auxílio Deslocamento.
E aí, vamos transformar o futuro da energia juntos?
Se você se identificou com a nossa missão e acredita que tem o perfil para este desafio, queremos te conhecer!

title: Técnico de Comissionamento de Subestações
description:
A Quadrante
Ao fazer parte do Grupo você terá a oportunidade de integrar um time jovem, dinâmico e ambicioso. Somos mais de 1000 profissionais empenhados no desenvolvimento das melhores soluções para o cliente e apostamos no crescimento profissional das nossas equipes, através da participação em projetos desafiantes.
O espírito de colaboração está presente no nosso DNA, tanto através da partilha de conhecimentos no dia-a-dia, quanto através de iniciativas que reforçam a comunidade. Acreditamos no potencial de cada um e queremos ajudá-lo a desenvolver as suas capacidades.

· Executar atividades de comissionamento de subestações MT/AT;
·
Realizar testes em:
Transformadores de potência e distribuição;

title: Pessoa Coordenadora De Qualidade
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Coordenar a equipe de SAC, recepção e Ambiência, visando a melhor experiência do cliente e a excelência em atendimento, tratando diretamente situações críticas de atendimento ao cliente e que necessitem de intervenção;
  • Coordenar a equipe do fraldário, proporcionando atendimento e ambientes agradáveis com excelência para aos clientes.
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores, bem como as pesquisas de NPS
  • Desenvolver e implementar políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de qualidade em todas as áreas sob sua responsabilidade, incluindo, atendimento, limpeza, paisagismo, higiene alimentar, dedetização, gestão de resíduos e reciclagem, obras em lojas e reformas internas;
  • Gerenciar as atividades de equipes terceirizadas que prestam serviços essenciais para o shopping, como limpeza, HSA, asseio, paisagismo, gestão de resíduos, reciclagem, aromatização.
  • Garantir que os restaurantes e as operações de alimentação do shopping sigam rigorosamente os padrões de higiene alimentar da Anvisa, com o controle e gestão da consultoria terceira, que realiza um ciclo de inspeções e ações corretivas, notificando as lojas inadequadas quando necessário.
  • Manter e aperfeiçoar o padrão de reciclagem e boas práticas sustentáveis que o Shopping realiza, com o intuito de ampliar e estender o programa, a fim de desenvolver e implantar melhores práticas para minimizar o impacto ambiental do shopping e atingir e mata da companhia.
  • Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS. Gerenciar as Obras e reformas de lojas no shopping, garantindo que as obras sejam executadas de acordo com os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e ocorram dentro do prazo programado.
  • Gerenciar e orientar equipe orgânica, garantindo que todos cumpram suas responsabilidades de forma eficaz.
  • Preparar relatórios de desempenho de qualidade e comunicar regularmente os resultados e problemas ao Gerente de Operações.
  • Garantir que o Shopping esteja em conformidade com todas as regulamentações e normas relevantes, incluindo as relacionadas à acessibilidade, segurança e higiene. Atentar aos prazos de vencimento de licenças e documentos.



Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Superior completo em Arquitetura, hotelaria ou turismo;
  • Domínio dos softwares AutoCAD e SketchUp;
  • Pacote Office avançado;
  • Power BI será um diferencial;
  • Experiência prévia em funções relacionadas à gestão da qualidade e atendimento em shopping centers ou em setores similares;
  • Conhecimento deregulamentações e normas de segurança e qualidade.

title: Diretor (A) De Arte
description:
Sobre a HIKE

A HIKE é uma Creative Company que inspira & transforma pessoas e marcas através do branding, design, produção de conteúdo digital, audiovisual e ativações. Atuamos desde os primeiros passos da jornada de uma marca até a concepção de grandes projetos para gigantes globais como AMBEV, Red Bull e Unilever.


Sobre a vaga

Você será responsável por liderar a direção de arte dos projetos de Branding da HIKE traduzindo estratégia de marca em sistemas visuais fortes, consistentes e aplicáveis no mundo real. Na prática, você é quem puxa a régua de qualidade do design, conduz rotas criativas, refina soluções até o nível máximo de acabamento e garante entregas impecáveis de design.


Nível do cargo

Sênior


Responsabilidades


  • Direção de arte de marcas: Liderar o desenvolvimento de sistemas visuais (identidades e key visuals), transformando insumos de estratégia (posicionamento, arquitetura, territórios, tom) em soluções visuais claras, proprietárias e autênticas.


  • Criação e evolução de identidades: Criar identidades completas (logo, paleta, tipografia, patterns, ilustrações, linguagem fotográfica e motion guidelines quando aplicável) e evoluir marcas existentes com consistência.


  • Packaging e design de key visuals: Desenvolver e/ou direcionar projetos de embalagem e key visuals.


  • Exploração criativa: Conduzir rotas criativas com clareza e repertório, testando caminhos antes de “fechar” a solução.


  • Padrão de craft: Ser referência de acabamento (tipografia, composição, hierarquia, cor, grid, micro detalhes), elevando o nível do time.


  • Gestão do time e/ou freelas: Direcionar e revisar entregas do time e/ou freelas, garantindo coerência com o sistema e nível de craft.


  • Feedback e iteração: Organizar rodadas de revisão (interno/cliente), filtrar feedback, priorizar ajustes e conduzir refinamentos sem perder o conceito.


  • Apresentação e defesa: Apresentar rotas e soluções com argumentação, critério e segurança;
    conduzir alinhamentos visuais e direcionar decisões.


Requisitos:

  • Portfólio robusto com projetos de branding (identidades e key visuals).
  • Experiência em conduzir rotas criativas e refinar soluções.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de design (Adobe CC).
  • Conhecimento sólido em construção de sistemas visuais.
  • Capacidade de traduzir estratégia de marca em decisões visuais (para além da estética).
  • Experiência em apresentar e defender trabalho para clientes, gerindo feedbacks com maturidade.

Sênior I

R$ 6.500,00/mês

Gympass

PJ

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Accounting Manager (Remote) – USA Clients

Location: Remote – LatAm

Salary: USD 2,500/month

Schedule: Based around US Timezones


About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.

The Accounting Manager (AM) is an expert responsible for overseeing financial accounting and transaction processing. They serve as ambassadors of TGG Way™ and US GAAP accounting standards . Accounting Managers provide 100% accurate and complete financial statements to Controllers. They play a key role in training and mentoring staff (both internal and external) on internal controls, systems, and processes following the TGG Way™ .

Additionally, Accounting Managers act as a bridge between TGG and the client , ensuring continuous communication, implementing processes, addressing client needs, and relaying key information to other team members.


Responsibilities

Financial Close & Month-End Management

  • Lead the month-end close process, ensuring adherence to the timeline and checklist.
  • Review final profit & loss (P&L) scrub and approve journal entries prepared by staff.
  • Ensure the accuracy of the balance sheet workbook, including spot-checking source document filing.
  • Review and update financial notes, charts, graphs, and footnotes to ensure alignment with KPIs and executive summaries.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Oversee the preparation of financial statements, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports.
  • Identify and resolve discrepancies in financial reports through variance analysis.
  • Review staff-prepared financial statements and supporting schedules.
  • Ensure financial accuracy and consistency across all reports and KPIs.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow Management

  • Lead budgeting and forecasting efforts for real estate projects, including capital expenditures and operating costs.
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to support cost-saving initiatives and revenue growth.
  • Update and maintain cash flow forecasts regularly.

Tax Compliance & Regulatory Filings

  • Prepare and submit sales tax returns with controller approval.
  • Coordinate, review, and submit annual 1099s.
  • Support the preparation and submission of personal property tax filings, reviewed by the controller.
  • Calculate monthly sales tax payments and submit them for controller review and remittance.

Accounting Operations & Oversight

  • Manage recurring weekly accounting processes as outlined by the controller.
  • Review customer invoicing, vendor bills, and process payments.
  • Approve and submit payroll.
  • Perform chart of accounts reviews and reclassify contributions/distributions to retained earnings as needed.

Team Leadership & Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Supervise and mentor junior accounting staff, fostering development in real estate accounting practices.
  • Collaborate with departments including property management, acquisitions, and finance to ensure effective financial operations and decision-making.

Process Improvement & Client Advisory

  • Identify opportunities for process efficiencies and provide actionable recommendations to clients.
  • Maintain strong financial integrity, proactively troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with accounting standards.

Tools, Communication & Task Management

  • Refine financial models and improve data structure in Excel.
  • Manage tasks using Asana and track time entries in Bizinta with detailed descriptions.
  • Organize and manage the accounting email inbox to ensure timely and accurate handling of financial documents.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of accounting experience, US based experience or familiarity required
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken).
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree.
  • Technical Knowledge: Proficiency in QuickBooks Online is a plus and Advanced Excel skills is required (complex formulas, data structuring, and basic financial modeling).
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.
  • Ability to prepare financial statements, carry out a month-end process, record and review journal entries in all accounts, and perform account reconciliations
  • Experience with US based clients and exposure to USGAAP.
  • US Working hours 9am to 5pm Eastern Standard Time.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.


Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy , including all Holidays
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and QuickBooks Online
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities


Notes:

This position is to join us as Independent Contractor

Payment after 90 days will be based on hours worked

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave



About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

The People Operations and Support (POPS) Team at TGG handles both the operational and human sides of the business. We’re a tight-knit, cross-functional group that collaborates closely with leaders across the company and with each other. Our work is fast-paced and wide-ranging, and we’re always looking for better ways to support our people and help the business run smoothly.


Our Core Values:

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

Other Traits

title: Fpga Engineer
description:
The Opportunity


Grass Valley’s FPGA Engineers develop state-of-the -art solutions for content creation, transmission, and distribution. We are dedicated to redefining the way audiences experience entertainment and information through cutting-edge technology. We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced FPGA Engineer specializing in Broadcast Video and Audio to join our team. As a FPGA Engineer, you will be instrumental in the design, development, testing and implementation of FPGA-based solutions specifically tailored for broadcast video and audio applications. Your responsibilities will encompass leading FPGA architecture design, electronic and PCB design and collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate these solutions into our broadcast systems.


Your Role

  • Lead the architecture, design, and development of FPGA-based systems for broadcast video and audio applications, focusing on Embedded System hardware and electronic design;
  • Optimize FPGA designs to enhance video processing, audio synchronization and develop electronic systems with FPGA architectures;
  • Conduct thorough simulation, testing, debugging, and verification of FPGA designs to ensure seamless functionality and adherence to industry standards;
  • Maintain and improve FPGA build processes using CI/CD tools like Jenkins;
  • Estimate work effort to establish schedules for design delivery;
  • Stay updated onindustry trends, emerging standards, and technologies related to broadcast video and audio.


Who you are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field;
  • Two (2) to five(5) years experience in FPGA design and development with strong focus on electronic and PCB design;
  • Proficiency in FPGA design, power estimation, implementation, optimization, testing, and development using hardware description languages (HDL) such as VHDL or Verilog;
  • Ability to simulate and verify FPGA designs using tools like Questa;
  • Familiarity with FPGA development tools such as Xilinx Vivado, or Altera Quartus;
  • Proficiency in debugging and troubleshooting FPGA designs, including using logic analyzers and other debugging tools;
  • Ability to create clear and concise documentation for FPGA designs, including design specifications;
  • Experience withembedded system integration and real-time operating systems running on inhouse designed hardware;
  • Experience in high-speed digital design, data serialization, media streaming (ST2110) and transmission protocols within the broadcast industry, particularly HD-SDI video;
  • Experience withhigh-speed serial interfaces like PCIe, DDR, Ethernet, and USB;
  • Knowledge of communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, UART, and CAN;
  • Strong understanding of digital logic design principles and ability to create complex digital circuits;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python and programming languages C/C++ for FPGA programming and automation;
  • Understanding TCP/IP from network programming perspective;
  • Experience in managing code with version control systems like Git to track releases and collaborate with a team through branching and merging;
  • Strong teamworkand communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional multi-site teams, including hardware engineers, QA engineers, and project managers;
  • Proven experience in hardware design and development, preferably in a similar role;
  • Experience withhardware debug and tests;
  • Strong knowledge of analog and digital electronics, microcontrollers, and FPGA;
  • Familiarity with industry standards, regulations, and compliance related to hardware design;
  • Proficiency in schematic capture and oversight of PCB layout;
  • Fluency in English, both oral and written.


Working Conditions

  • Competitive Compensation packages
  • Energizing and supportive work environment
  • Remote work



  • This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work involved for this job. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of this job.

Oportunidade

Location: Remote — Brazil/US time zones (EST ±3h) - Contract: International contractor, $35/hour - Language: English (fluent) - Reports to: CTO & Engineering team.



About the role

Volatus is hiring a Senior Fullstack Engineer to own critical product work on a next‑generation platform for fertility clinics and their patients. You will join as a founding engineer, shaping both the product and the technical direction in a category where better software directly improves patient outcomes.


Tech context

You will work in a modern, greenfield stack centered on:

  • Frontend: Next.Js/React , Typescript , Tailwind CSS
  • Backend: Node.Js/TypeScript with a PostgreSQL core (schema design, authN,authZ, performance, transactions, triggers).
  • Data & integrations: Third-party API integrations ;
    performance profiling (e.G., Lighthouse).
  • Quality: Unit, integration, and end-to-end tests;
    CI/CD .
  • Collaboration: Work closely with our Head of Engineering, Principal Engineer, Product Designer, and CEO.


What you will do

  • Build and ship end‑to‑end features across the Next.Js frontend and Node/TypeScript backend.
  • Model and tune Postgres schemas;
    ensure secure authN/authZ and strong performance.
  • Integrate external APIs and improve app reliability and speed (including Lighthouse‑driven improvements).
  • Write reliable tests (unit/integration/e2e) and contribute to CI/CD workflows.
  • Make pragmatic early‑stage architectural decisions and raise the engineering bar.


What you will bring

  • Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate development and quality.
  • Strong production experience with Next.Js/React, Node.Js, and TypeScript.
  • Tailwind & CSS mastery;
    responsive, accessible UI.
  • PostgreSQL expertise (modeling, security/auth, performance, transactions, triggers).
  • Integrations experience (third‑party APIs) and solid testing practice (unit/integration/e2e).
  • Portfolio or links to shipped projects/code.


90-day outcomes

In your first 90 days, you will:

  • Lead at least one significant feature from design to production, used by real clinics or internal teams.
  • Improve a key part of the frontend experience (e.G., performance, usability, or design consistency) and document the standards for others.
  • Own part of the backend or data model, including at least one meaningful performance or reliability improvement.
  • Help define or refine testing and deployment practices so the team can ship faster and with more confidence.


Nice to have

  • Experience building voice‑controlled components / speech‑to‑text.
  • Experience interacting with AI models from the web app.


How we work

  • Remote within EST ±3 hours preferred ;
    open to other time zones if you can collaborate on US‑friendly hours.
  • Small, senior team with a strong bias toward action and ownership ;
  • Product-led culture : engineers are closely involved in discovery, tradeoff discussions, and shaping the roadmap.


Hiring process

  • Coderpad Challenge (60 min)
  • Intro chat (45 min) – mutual fit and role context.
  • Technical deep‑dive & Live testing – discuss systems you’ve built;
    pair on a focused problem (no whiteboard trivia).
  • Team conversation – meet engineering + product leadership.
  • References & offer.


Volatus is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

  • Experience with cloud-based analytical databases.

title: Pessoa coordenadora de qualidade
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Coordenar a equipe de SAC, recepção e Ambiência, visando a melhor experiência do cliente e a excelência em atendimento, tratando diretamente situações críticas de atendimento ao cliente e que necessitem de intervenção;
Coordenar a equipe do fraldário, proporcionando atendimento e ambientes agradáveis com excelência para aos clientes.
Acompanhar e analisar indicadores, bem como as pesquisas de NPS
Desenvolver e implementar políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de qualidade em todas as áreas sob sua responsabilidade, incluindo, atendimento, limpeza, paisagismo, higiene alimentar, dedetização, gestão de resíduos e reciclagem, obras em lojas e reformas internas;
Gerenciar as atividades de equipes terceirizadas que prestam serviços essenciais para o shopping, como limpeza, HSA, asseio, paisagismo, gestão de resíduos, reciclagem, aromatização.
Garantir que os restaurantes e as operações de alimentação do shopping sigam rigorosamente os padrões de higiene alimentar da Anvisa, com o controle e gestão da consultoria terceira, que realiza um ciclo de inspeções e ações corretivas, notificando as lojas inadequadas quando necessário.
Manter e aperfeiçoar o padrão de reciclagem e boas práticas sustentáveis que o Shopping realiza, com o intuito de ampliar e estender o programa, a fim de desenvolver e implantar melhores práticas para minimizar o impacto ambiental do shopping e atingir e mata da companhia.
Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS. Gerenciar as Obras e reformas de lojas no shopping, garantindo que as obras sejam executadas de acordo com os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e ocorram dentro do prazo programado.
Gerenciar e orientar equipe orgânica, garantindo que todos cumpram suas responsabilidades de forma eficaz.
Preparar relatórios de desempenho de qualidade e comunicar regularmente os resultados e problemas ao Gerente de Operações.
Garantir que o Shopping esteja em conformidade com todas as regulamentações e normas relevantes, incluindo as relacionadas à acessibilidade, segurança e higiene. Atentar aos prazos de vencimento de licenças e documentos.

title: Pessoa coordenadora de qualidade
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.Responsabilidades e atribuições:Coordenar a equipe de SAC, recepção e Ambiência, visando a melhor experiência do cliente e a excelência em atendimento, tratando diretamente situações críticas de atendimento ao cliente e que necessitem de intervenção;
Coordenar a equipe do fraldário, proporcionando atendimento e ambientes agradáveis com excelência para aos clientes.
Acompanhar e analisar indicadores, bem como as pesquisas de NPS
Desenvolver e implementar políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de qualidade em todas as áreas sob sua responsabilidade, incluindo, atendimento, limpeza, paisagismo, higiene alimentar, dedetização, gestão de resíduos e reciclagem, obras em lojas e reformas internas;
Gerenciar as atividades de equipes terceirizadas que prestam serviços essenciais para o shopping, como limpeza, HSA, asseio, paisagismo, gestão de resíduos, reciclagem, aromatização.
Garantir que os restaurantes e as operações de alimentação do shopping sigam rigorosamente os padrões de higiene alimentar da Anvisa, com o controle e gestão da consultoria terceira, que realiza um ciclo de inspeções e ações corretivas, notificando as lojas inadequadas quando necessário.
Manter e aperfeiçoar o padrão de reciclagem e boas práticas sustentáveis que o Shopping realiza, com o intuito de ampliar e estender o programa, a fim de desenvolver e implantar melhores práticas para minimizar o impacto ambiental do shopping e atingir e mata da companhia.
Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS. Gerenciar as Obras e reformas de lojas no shopping, garantindo que as obras sejam executadas de acordo com os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e ocorram dentro do prazo programado.
Gerenciar e orientar equipe orgânica, garantindo que todos cumpram suas responsabilidades de forma eficaz.
Preparar relatórios de desempenho de qualidade e comunicar regularmente os resultados e problemas ao Gerente de Operações.
Garantir que o Shopping esteja em conformidade com todas as regulamentações e normas relevantes, incluindo as relacionadas à acessibilidade, segurança e higiene. Atentar aos prazos de vencimento de licenças e documentos.Requisitos e qualificações:Superior completo em Arquitetura, hotelaria ou turismo;
Domínio dos softwares Auto CAD e Sketch Up;
Pacote Office avançado;

description:

Utilizamos aplicativos móveis que facilitam o processo de aprendizagem, envolvendo professores, alunos e escolas, do ensino fundamental ao ensino superior. Design de Software:Habilidades em design de software, práticas de codificação limpa e arquitetura de sistemas.
Controle de Versão:Familiaridade com ferramentas de controle de versão, como Git, para gerenciar e compartilhar código.
Trabalho em Equipe:Capacidade de colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais, habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas.
Serão considerados diferenciais conhecimentos em outras linguagens de programação, experiência em metodologias ágeis e formação na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou afins.Interessado? Envie seu currículo diretamente ao nosso head: Paulo Afonso C. Arruda, pelo e-mail: ONIlearning Technology agradece antecipadamente o seu interesse em fazer parte de nosso time de campeões!Paulo Afonso Cardoso de Arruda
Head de Operações e Tecnologia

title: College-level chemistry tutor
description:
We are looking for tutors to solve college-level Chemistry questions in English. These questions are submitted by students, who expect a response in less than 24 hours.Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.We need tutors who can start immediately!CharacteristicsPayment in dollars.

Start: Immediate
Duration: IndefiniteRequirementsAbility to solve university-level questions in at least one of the following subjects:
General Chemistry
Organic Chemistry
Student or graduate of a university course whose curriculum includes at least one of the subjects listed in the previous point.
Computer with an Internet connection.
No criminal record.About Latin HireFounded in 2003, Latin Hire is a company specialising in managing teams of experts for distance learning institutions. Its clients include some of the world's most prestigious education startups.

title: Devops engineer
description:
Important Information
Location:Brazil
Job Mode:Full-time
Work Mode:Work from homeJob Summary
As a Dev Ops Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, observability, and security by collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. The Dev Ops engineer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization. This role plays a fundamental role in driving the adoption of cloud platform capabilities in collaboration with software engineering, architecture, and information security teamsResponsibilities and Duties
Deploy & Configure AWS Cloud Services;
Deploy & Configure Kubernetes resources;
Help elaborating or contributing to RFC and ADRs documents describing technical solutions;
Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) – Automate infrastructure deployment;
CI/CD Pipeline Automation – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Git Hub Actions;
Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.Essential Skills
Experience in a Dev Ops role, with hands-on AWS experience;
Experience with Ia C tools, ideally Terraform and Helm Charts;
Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes);
Familiarity with CI/CD tools like Circle CI and Github Actions;
Experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda, VPC);
Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments;
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills;
Familiarity with Ruby or Golang;
Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Shell, or Python).Highly Desirable Skills
Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, Zero Trust, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;
Monitoring & Observability – Experience using Datadog, Cloud Watch;
Experience with Kubernetes packet managers (e.g. Helm, Kubectl);
AWS Certified Dev Ops Engineer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.About EncoraEncora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, Dev Sec Ops, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

Important Information
Location:Brazil
Job Mode:Full-time
Work Mode:Work from homeJob Summary
As a Dev Ops Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, observability, and security by collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. The Dev Ops engineer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization. This role plays a fundamental role in driving the adoption of cloud platform capabilities in collaboration with software engineering, architecture, and information security teamsResponsibilities and Duties
Deploy & Configure AWS Cloud Services;
Deploy & Configure Kubernetes resources;
Help elaborating or contributing to RFC and ADRs documents describing technical solutions;
Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) – Automate infrastructure deployment;
CI/CD Pipeline Automation – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Git Hub Actions;
Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.Essential Skills
Experience in a Dev Ops role, with hands-on AWS experience;
Experience with Ia C tools, ideally Terraform and Helm Charts;
Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes);
Familiarity with CI/CD tools like Circle CI and Github Actions;
Experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda, VPC);
Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments;
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills;
Familiarity with Ruby or Golang;
Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Shell, or Python).Highly Desirable Skills
Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, Zero Trust, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;
Monitoring & Observability – Experience using Datadog, Cloud Watch;
Experience with Kubernetes packet managers (e.g. Helm, Kubectl);
AWS Certified Dev Ops Engineer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.About EncoraEncora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, Dev Sec Ops, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Especialista salesforce
description:
Sobre a EmpresaHá mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.Sobre o Cargo: Especialista SalesforceResponsabilidades:
Perfil de liderança
Desenvolver soluções customizadas na plataforma Salesforce utilizando Apex, LWC (Lightning Web Components), Visualforce e triggers.
Implementar integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST/SOAP.
Criar automações avançadas, componentes reutilizáveis e testes unitários com alta cobertura.
Otimizar queries e gerenciar limites da plataforma (governor limits).
Colaborar com times funcionais e administradores para entrega de soluções técnicas aderentes aos requisitos de negócio.
Apoiar a gestão do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento (Dev Ops), incluindo controle de versões e deploys com ferramentas como SFDX, Git e pipelines de CI/CDRequisitos:
Domínio de todas as etapas do ciclo no Salesforce
Experiência prévia em projetos Salesforce (atuando como desenvolvedor).
Vivência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e em squads multidisciplinares.
Experiência prática com integrações complexas e grandes volumes de dados.Desejávelexperiência em projetos de implementação de soluções escaláveis em empresas de médio e grande porte.Modelo de trabalho:
100% remoto
CLT
Benefícios:
Vale Refeição - Cartão flash
Plano de saúde
Plano odontológico

title: Vendedor
description:
Vaga para Vendedora em Clínica de Transplante Capilar
Você é apaixonada por vendas e deseja atuar em um mercado em crescimento? Venha fazer parte da nossa equipe!
Estamos em busca de uma vendedora dedicada para integrar nossa clínica especializada em transplante capilar. Se você tem facilidade de comunicação, gosta de desafios e está em busca de uma oportunidade que valorize seu potencial, essa vaga é para você!Responsabilidades:
- Atendimento ao cliente, fornecendo informações detalhadas sobre os serviços de transplante capilar.
- Prospecção de novos clientes e manutenção de um bom relacionamento com os já existentes.
- Acompanhamento de todas as etapas do processo de vendas, garantindo a satisfação do cliente.
- Fechamento de vendas e acompanhamento pós-venda.
- Cumprimento das metas estabelecidas pela equipe de vendas.Requisitos:
- Experiência prévia em vendas, preferencialmente no ramo da saúde ou estética.
- Habilidade de comunicação e persuasão.
- Foco em resultados e superação de metas.
- Proatividade, organização e comprometimento.O que oferecemos:
-*Salário fixo*compatível com o mercado.

title: Sales manager -  nutraceutical ingredients ( latam)
description:
Sales Manager - Nutraceutical Ingredients ( LATAM)Location: Brazil (Remote)Territory: Latin AmericaAbout the RoleWe’re seeking a Sales Manager to drive growth across LATAM. You will sell nutraceutical ingredients to the dietary supplement and functional food & beverage industries, building a high-quality pipeline and long-term customer relationships.Responsibilities
• Manage and grow key accounts across LATAM, fostering senior-level relationships with brand owners, CDMOs/contract manufacturers, and distributors.
• Develop and execute country- and segment-level territory plans to capture new business.
• Present nutraceutical ingredients to customers, clearly articulating benefits, applications, and go-to-market plans.
• Collaborate with technical, regulatory, and marketing teams to deliver tailored solutions and product launches.
• Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify white space and protect share.
• Meet and exceed quarterly/annual sales targets with accurate forecasting and disciplined CRM hygiene.
• Represent the company at regional trade shows, conferences, and industry events.
• Provide technical/product support to customers in coordination with internal teams.
• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of regional regulations and standards (e.g., ANVISA, COFEPRIS, INVIMA).Requirements
• 5+ years of B2 B sales experience in nutraceutical ingredients within LATAM.
• Strong understanding of nutraceutical ingredients and their applications in dietary supplements and functional F&B.
• Proven ability to prospect, build pipelines, negotiate, and close across multiple countries.
• Language: Fluent Portuguese and strong Spanish; English is a plus.
• Self-starter comfortable working remotely; excellent territory/time management.
• Based in Brazil with willingness to travel across LATAM as required.
• Proficiency with MS Office and CRM (ZOHO preferred).

title: Pessoa engenheira de dados  - vaga afirmativa para mulheres cis e trans
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.
Quem somos:
Nós da Artefact Lat Am acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

title: Data engineer - fluent english
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!
What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.
Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
Collaboratewith data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
OptimizeETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
Maintainand improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
Troubleshootand resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.
What we are looking for:
A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
Curiosity:You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
Collaboration:Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
Entrepreneurship:You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
Fluent English:You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.
What We Offer:
Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
Gympass
Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)Why you should join us
Artefact is the place to be:come and build the future of marketing
Progress:every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
Culture:join the best team you could ever imagine

description:

Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. Strong knowledge of IT Service Management, SAP Basis and SAP Applications
Hands-on experience with SAP Basis activities, SAP release version upgrades and infrastructure updates for cloud customers
Working experience with SAP HEC, SAP S/4 HANA or any other cloud solution.
Hands-on experience with infrastructure operations, network, interfaces and Load Balancer topics related to SAP landscape management (TLO)
Strong technical troubleshooting skills with the ability to form the solution/designing the mechanism for end to end solutioning
Hands on experience in Migration (onpremise to Cloud/Cross cloud/Cross DC's)Soft Skills
Excellent customer focus / Networking / Relationship Building /Results-driven / Self-organized / Decision making
Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)
Understanding of escalation handling and procedures with customers while proactively working with internal teams towards arriving at a resolution
Experience in working with cross-cultural and cross-functional teams or individuals
Proficiency in English (Written and verbal)Good to have
Cloud architecture and IT technical infrastructure know-how
Knowledge of/certification in one of Azure, AWS or GCP fundamentals
Experience with Migration, Upgrade projects esp. on S/4 H Cloud
Knowledge of Project Management Fundamentals, ITIL, Lean Fundamentals is a plusWhat can you expect from us?• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.
• Opportunities to work outside Brazil
• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.What do we offer?TCS Benefits – Brazil:
Health insurance
Dental Plan
Life insurance
Transportation vouchers
Meal/Food Voucher
Childcare assistance

Reimbursement of Certifications

International experience opportunity
Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

title: Api engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.We are looking forAPI Designer/Engineerwho wants to learn and transform his career.In this role you will: (responsibilities)Overview
The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.Key Responsibilities
API Design & Development
Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage Open API (Swagger), RAML, or Async API specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API Dev Ops framework.
Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.API Consumer Onboarding
Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/Open ID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.Testing & Validation
Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.Skills and Expertise
API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using Open API, Swagger Hub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, Open ID Connect, and API key management best practices.
Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman toolWhat can you expect from us?• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.
• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

title: Data scientist - fluent english
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!What you will be doing:
You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.
Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems
What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment
What we offer:Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
Gympass
Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)Why you should join us
Artefact is the place to be:come and build the future of marketing
Progress:every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
Culture:join the best team you could ever imagine
Entrepreneurship:you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!
Come join us!

title: Data scientist - fluent english
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!What you will be doing:
You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.
Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems
What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment
What we offer:Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
Gympass
Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)Why you should join us
Artefact is the place to be:come and build the future of marketing
Progress:every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
Culture:join the best team you could ever imagine
Entrepreneurship:you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!
Come join us!

title: Principal ai engineer - ai in healthcare
description:
WHO WE AREWe are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:
Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
Automated coding and billing optimization
Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials
Seamless compliance with value-based care requirementsJoin us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOUThis is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.KEY RESPONSIBILITIESVery hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!1. Build and Refine AI Products
Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy
Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy3. Own the Development Lifecycle
Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement
Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge baseREQUIRED EXPERTISE1. Technical Skills
Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, Open AI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (Postgre SQL)2. Mindset & Approach
Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment
Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing3. Highly Valued Qualifications
Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, Git Hub Copilot, or similar
Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (Lang Chain, Llama Index, or similar)
Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle managementHealthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.WHAT WE OFFER1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity
Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential
Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale2. Professional Excellence
Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems
Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside3. Work-Life Integration
Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily
Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainabilityREADY FOR THE CHALLENGE?If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

title: Indirect tax manager
description:
About Us:
Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.We are seeking a proactive and experiencedTax BPto support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.Job description
The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.Desired profile
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
Knowledge in Tax reform;
Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;Language:
Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.

description:
About Us
Cadence ( ) is a language services firm servicing the due diligence industry.
